# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2007

**Kautusang Pambayan Blg. 03**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance No. 03 (Kautusang Pambayan Blg. 03), Series of [[2007]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on October 1, 2007. This ordinance regulates the size of commercial and residential lots along the national highway outside the campus of Tulok Ha (approximately 0.01 km). It establishes planning standards for commercial lot development, restricts construction near the highway, and mandates coordination with the Municipal Fisheries and Aquatic Resource Management Council (MFARMC).

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1** — Standardization of commercial lot sizes: Commercial lots along the national highway in the municipality's central area (poblacion) shall have standard dimensions of twenty (20) feet in length and twenty (20) meters in width, measured from the highway boundary to the interior of Pitogo, Quezon.
- **Section 2** — Classification of commercial establishments: All structures intended for commercial use (pamahayang komersyal) shall be classified accordingly.
- **Section 3** — No commercial structure shall be built on municipal/public land within the campus area extending 100.3 hectares until the municipal boundary of Pitogo is established.
- **Section 4** — Commercial establishments and residences on the national road must comply with existing building codes, and building owners must secure permits.
- **Section 5** — Penalties: Any person violating this ordinance shall be penalized in accordance with the law governing municipalities, including possible referral to the Municipal Fisheries and Aquatic Resource Management Council (MFARMC).
- **Section 6** — All existing ordinances or parts thereof inconsistent with this ordinance are hereby repealed.
- **Section 7** — Joint enforcement: This ordinance shall be enforced jointly by the municipal government of Pitogo and its component barangays.
- **Section 8** — This ordinance shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication.
